test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following rivers of India flows from east to west?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Narmada.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Narmada and Tapti** are major West flowing rivers.
 
• The Narmada, **the largest west-flowing river of the Peninsula,** rises near the Amarkantak range of mountains in **Madhya Pradesh**.
 
• It is the** fifth largest river **in the country and the largest one in Gujarat.
 
• It is also called as the** "Life Line of Madhya Pradesh and Gujarat" **due to **its huge contribution to the two states in many ways**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca88f5590af2e8068ab3943512a6ffbf9078cc880c9c928458be93d37f203706.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Godavari River** rises from **Trimbakeshwar in the Nashik district of Maharashtra**. 
 
• It is the oldest River in India. 
 
• Tunga and Bhadra together form the **Tungabhadra River**, which is a sacred river in** Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh.**
 
• The Mahanadi is a major river in East Central India.
